answer: Reaching eligibility takes 21 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. The prism register is checked at draw time, nectar lists the eligible set, and delta seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 21 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 24 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
